      Description

      Sturdy

      Flexible doesn’t mean flimsy
      The E7 standing desk is specially designed to be sturdy—and will stay stable at any height, even when your workload gets heavy.
      Thicker leg columns and optimal column gap design:
      ensures that stages of columns move smoothly and seamlessly
      Solid carbon steel base structure:
      guarantees a durable and sturdy experience
      Stable at every angle
      Steady when moving
      Sturdy at the highest level

      Weight Capacity

      Strong Enough for Two
      With a weight capacity of 355lbs, the E7 can easily hold the weight of two adults, making it a perfect solution for a versatile workstation.
      E7 Pro has an unbeatable weight-bearing capacity of 440 lbs – that’s 2,434 cups of coffee to get you through the day. You can fit all your essentials on this standing desk without a problem.

      Quality Craftsmanship

      Expertly Crafted for Durability, Aesthetics, and Sustainability
      Sleek and Durable:

      Industry-leading laser-welding technique

      Aesthetically Pleasing:

      Holeless leg design

      Outstanding Color Consistency:

      High temperature-resistant and anti-wear coating

      Sustainable Quality:

      Nordson Enviro Coat powder spraying system

      Upright vs. Inverted Structure

      A Head-to-Head Battle of Stability and Experience
      Upright Mount
      Lower center of gravity
      Superior stability
      Higher weight capacity
      Ideal for large desktops
      Inverted Mount
      Higher center of gravity
      More wobble risk
      Lower load capacity
      Best for small desktops
      Upright-mounted motors offer up to 42% better lateral stability under real-world working conditions.

      Cord Management

      Clutter-free work station
      For a sleeker, more comfortable workspace, the cable tray under the E7 desktop tucks all your cables out of view—and out of reach for curious kids or pesky pets.
      E7 Pro is one-of-a-kind with its cord management system. The discreet cable tray underneath the desk gives you a safe place to tuck away power cables. Magnetic fabric cable cover to keep your workspace looking spick and span.

      Shipping Info & Return Policy

      We ship to 48 states in the U.S. from 10 US warehouses via FedEx for free. If you are shipping to Alaska or Hawaii, you will be charged the FedEx posted rate. For orders shipping to Puerto Rico, or any country other than the U.S., please give us a call at(855) 585-5618.

      You are free to return almost any item within 30 days of receipt. A 30-day risk-free policy applies to all items. No restocking fee is applied for items returned in "like new" condition. No shipping fee is applied for the return of the item.

      Certain FlexiSpot products are eligible for our premium delivery services.
